name: Building a case
prompt: Three patrol notes name the same corner and the same man. The case file needs one buy you can show a judge.

choices.text: Keep watching and add to the file

outcome.told: Another week of notes. The file is thicker and the corner is the same.
The buy goes as planned and the warrant is signed by the afternoon. The arrest is clean.

failure.told: He doesn't show. Someone told him. The file goes back in the drawer.
